newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Raiffeisen bank takes up $60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Raiffeisen bank takes up $60 mln loan.

text.p: Hungary's Raiffeisen Unicbank, the subsidiary of Austria's Raiffeisen bank, took up a syndicated loan of $60 million from the international market, the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Thursday.
Raiffeisen Unicbank originally planned to borrow $50 million, but the syndicated loan lead managed by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell was oversubscribed, MTI said quoting Raiffeisen Unicbank officials.
The interest rate of the five-year loan is LIBOR + 0.1875 percent, the lowest ever interest rate at which Hungarian banks have taken up a loan from abroad, MTI said.
The bank will use the loan for financing medium- and long-term projects for its clients, it added.
